events.outcome: Current Hala evidence establishes a QAR10 minimum recharge, 30-day active credit validity followed by 179 days of grace before line deactivation, passport/QID verification and current prepaid roaming coverage including China; OTP reliability remains unverified.

data.acquisitionSummary: Ooredoo currently offers Hala prepaid through its eShop with a free SIM and same-day Qatar delivery, plus eSIM activation. Identity verification supports an original QID or passport with selfie/video verification. This establishes a current local/nonresident acquisition path, not China-first remote delivery.

keep.action: A QAR10-99 recharge gives 30 days of credit/line validity. After expiry Hala remains in grace for 179 days, during which Ooredoo says incoming calls/SMS remain available while outgoing/data are barred. Recharging during grace reactivates the line. Using the QAR10 floor before the 179-day grace ends gives a maximum number-retention cycle of about 209 days; two QAR10 recharges cover more than one year if timed near the provider limits.

data.chinaActivation: Current eShop fulfillment is Qatar-local. Passport identity verification supports nonresidents, but China-first purchase/delivery or activation was not established.
data.kyc: Current Ooredoo identity flow accepts an original QID or passport and requires selfie/video verification; nonresident passport acquisition is supported by the reviewed flow.
data.payment: Ooredoo eTopUp allows QAR10-QAR500 and states that most local and international debit/credit cards plus Apple Pay are accepted, subject to risk controls.
data.roamingSms: Ooredoo’s 2026 prepaid roaming tariff includes China. The reviewed current tariff prices sent SMS but does not separately state an incoming-SMS charge; third-party OTP delivery and incoming-SMS reliability in China remain unverified.
data.tariffSummary: Free Hala SIM/eSIM online; QAR10 minimum top-up gives 30 active days, followed by 179-day grace before deactivation. Passport/QID verification and prepaid China roaming are currently documented.
guideSteps: Acquire Hala through the current Qatar eShop/local channel and complete QID/passport identity verification.
For number retention, recharge before the 179-day grace period ends; do not confuse grace-state incoming SMS permission with guaranteed third-party OTP delivery abroad.
Treat China roaming support as carrier coverage evidence only, not an OTP success-rate claim.
